title: PMI Fully-Toleranced Test Case 9 - View A
doubts: All annotations are drawn in isometric planes (about 30 degrees); every box is the axis-aligned box enclosing the rotated text or frame, so boxes of stacked items overlap.
Feature control frames printed under an nX size callout carry that callout's multiplier (same convention as the d2mi hand keys); frames with their own printed nX use it.
T13 and T14 are composite position frames: one item per row, the shared position symbol written on both rows. Both rows of each are keyed with the 3X of the size callout.
D10 and D11 print 3X although the FSI lists four holes per pattern (F20-F23, F24-F27); keyed as printed (3X).
D8 (4X .03 ±.01 X .03 ±.01) keyed as chamfer (FSI: chamfers, cones).
T29 has an all-around circle on its leader (FSI: Profile .05|A|B|C All Around); the symbol is on the leader, not text, so the frame text omits it.

Notes block (STR6): note 5 MATERIAL kept as a requirement. Excluded: note 1 (CAD MODEL REV IS REQUIRED), note 2 (precedence), note 3 (applicable standards), note 6 (UNITS: INCHES), and note 4 (values in square brackets are millimeters), which is a units convention like note 6.
Excluded per brief: DF1-DF3 datum feature symbols, CS1 coordinate system, title and header text.
